**Subject: Executive Briefing proposal for Tamarack Instruments**

Dear Dana Whitfield,

**Situation**

Tamarack Instruments designs and manufactures laboratory measurement instruments and operates in the Netherlands, Germany and the United States. A customer service chatbot is deployed on the support portal, AI visual inspection is being piloted on the German production line and AI sales forecasting is planned for next year. An internal audit finding in June 2026 recorded no inventory of AI systems. You have stated: "I want governance in place before visual inspection goes into production in Q2 2027." Customer data must stay in the EU; the German works council is consulted before anything touches production staff.

**What the Briefing covers for the Client**

The session will map the EU AI Act and GDPR to the three use cases. These will be presented as expectations to verify with counsel, not legal advice. Questions include how visual inspection may be classified and what transparency expectations may apply to the chatbot. United States requirements appear only as a general landscape item. The readiness discussion is anchored to the Client's piloting maturity and the June 2026 finding. It is framed around Slow AI, Informed Intent and Final Liability rests with the Human.

The operating model segment uses the GRC Workbook (https://github.com/rolldabones/grc-workbook) and Slow AI Kitchen (https://github.com/rolldabones/slow-ai-kitchen). It considers how AI governance could connect to the Client's ISO/IEC 27001 information security management system, ISO 9001 quality management system and internal audit function. Board-level points draw on AI Governance for Boards (https://github.com/rolldabones/ai-governance-for-boards). The Briefing also addresses how this work relates to ISO/IEC 42001 preparation, which is to start next year. It does not confer certification or assure any audit or regulatory outcome.

**Logistics and price**

The Executive Briefing is two hours, delivered live and virtually, for US$3,000. The session date is Unknown and will be confirmed at intake. The audience roles named are General Counsel, CISO, Head of Quality, Head of Data, German plant manager and two internal auditors. We will confirm attendees at intake.

**What the Client receives afterward**

The Client receives a post-briefing summary memo recording decisions surfaced and readiness observations. It includes three prioritized recommendations, each mapped to a next program option: Executive Workshop, Practitioner Academy or Implementation Accelerator.

**Next step**

A decision is expected by 15 December 2026. Please reply with a preferred session date and the attendee list. We will then send intake questions, including the planned ISO/IEC 42001 start date, which is not yet fixed.

Kind regards,

AI Governance Academy
